newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR mostly steady despite T-bill drop.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR mostly steady despite T-bill drop.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were mostly unchanged on Tuesday despite an across-the-board drop in Treasury bill rates, traders said.
"PHIBOR rates have moved ahead of the T-bill rates. PHIBOR rates have been sliding since last week in anticipation of the decline," one trader said.
The benchmark 91-day T-bill rate dropped to 10.529 percent on Monday from the previous week's 10.892.
One-week, three-month and one-year Phibor slipped while the others remained unchanged.
